name: Zedekiah
bio: Mattaniah, son of Josiah and brother of Jehoahaz, was installed as king of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar after the deportation of his nephew Jehoiachin; Nebuchadnezzar renamed him Zedekiah. He began to reign at twenty-one and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; his mother was Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah. He did evil in the LORD's eyes like Jehoiakim before him, and eventually rebelled against Babylon, a decision driven, Scripture says, by the LORD's anger finally casting Judah from his presence (2 Kings 24:17-20). His rebellion and Jerusalem's catastrophic fall are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
